description: ACCDB table T with no AutoNumber column (ID LONG PK, K LONG unique, S TEXT(50)) and one existing row (1, 400, 'pre') so the data page has room. Src has row 1 (ID 10, K 400) duplicating existing K on UK. INSERT INTO T SELECT ... ORDER BY N with dbFailOnError fails 3022 on row 1 by the second unique index UK. Keeps pages 0-1 and 42+ after setup, after statement (1500 ms pause), and after follow-up INSERT; reads TableDef.RecordCount and rows.
retentionNote: Q1: no AutoNumber, existing ACCDB page, 3022 by UK on row 1 -> p0 +1 (08->09), p42[16]=01, p42[67]=01->02, p42[79]=01
